children: Rent the Runway reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $97.7 million, up 20.8% year-over-year, with gross profit of $35.3 million and gross margin of 36.1%. The company posted a net loss of $12.9 million and adjusted EBITDA of $12.6 million for the quarter. Rent the Runway also announced Paige Thomas as CEO and president and Teri Bariquit as chair of the board, effective mid-September 2026.
Total revenue: $97.7 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026 (up 20.8% YoY).
Gross profit: $35.3 million; gross margin: 36.1% (compared with 30.0% in Q2 FY2025).
Operating loss: $(7.8) million for the quarter.
Net loss: $(12.9) million for the quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA: $12.6 million; Adjusted EBITDA margin: 12.9% for the quarter.
Subscriber metrics: ending active subscribers of 140,826 (down 3.8% YoY); average active subscribers of 148,259 (up 1.0% YoY); ending total subscribers of 186,019 (up 0.5% YoY).

Add-on business acceleration: add-on bookings increased 81% YoY in Q2 and 33% of subscribers used an add-on during the quarter (versus 29% a year ago), driven by higher engagement and membership flexibility.

Discovery and AI initiatives: completed rollout of AI-powered outfits generation to all customers (feature engagement ~35% in-app) and rolled out avatars within the outfits experience; piloting virtual try-on tools.

Refocused operations: prioritized core rental and selling businesses, paused several pilots including the online marketplace pilot and on-site advertising/monetization, and paused pursuit of new B2B dry cleaning opportunities to concentrate resources on customer-valued experiences such as Reserve.

Capital allocation and liquidity focus: updating rental product acquired guidance for FY26 to $53–55 million (from $74.9 million in FY25) and reaffirming double-digit revenue growth and adjusted EBITDA margin of 4%–7% for fiscal 2026 while citing continued efforts to strengthen liquidity.
